images: Holds image records for objects — one row per image (grain: one image) with keys/IDs object_id and original_image_url/gcs_url and metadata fields public_caption, title, caption, is_oasc.
objects: Holds museum object records — one row per object (grain: one object) with primary key object_number/object_id and attributes including is_highlight, is_public_domain, department, object_name, title, culture, period, dynasty, reign, portfolio, artist_* fields (artist_role, artist_prefix, artist_display_name, artist_display_bio, artist_suffix, artist_alpha_sort, artist_nationality, artist_begin_date, artist_end_date), object_date/object_begin_date/object_end_date, medium, dimensions, credit_line, geographic fields (geography_type, city, state, county, country, region, subregion, locale, locus, excavation, river), classification, and rights_and_reproduction.
vision_api_data: Holds Vision API analysis for images — one row per analyzed object/image (grain: one object_id's vision results) keyed by object_id with annotation fields faceAnnotations, landmarkAnnotations, cropHintsAnnotation, logoAnnotations, labelAnnotations, textAnnotations, fullTextAnnotation, imagePropertiesAnnotation, safeSearchAnnotation, webDetection.
